description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultPluginHandler' that implements a method to register a default plugin handler in the Smarty templating engine. The class contains a property indicating applicability to Smarty objects and a method that validates and sets a callback for plugin handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultPluginHandler
classes.description: A class providing functionality to register a default plugin handler within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: registerDefaultPluginHandler
methods.description: Registers a default plugin handler callback. Validates if the callback is callable and assigns it to the Smarty object, throwing an exception if invalid.
